about.title: A day of Japanese culture, flavours and experiences
paragraphs: The Japanese Day of Tea and Culture, also known by the shorter name Japan Day Chýně, is a festival of Japanese culture, food and traditions held in Chýně near Prague.

It brings together Japanese cuisine, traditional arts, martial arts, music, dance and Japanese tea in one place. Throughout the day, the stage will host guests and groups with a genuine, long-term connection to Japan.

The event will also feature sales and presentation stands with a Japanese theme. The Japanese Day of Tea and Culture 2026 takes place on 10 October 2026 at ZŠ Bolzanova, Bolzanova 800, Chýně near Prague.

practical.title: When, where and admission
practical.transport: Chýně is located on the western edge of Prague. Detailed information about public transport, travel and parking will be added before the event.
practical.accessibility: Accessibility information will be added once the organisational details have been confirmed.

faq.question: When does the Japanese Day of Tea and Culture 2026 take place?
faq.answer: On Saturday, 10 October 2026. The hall opens to the public at 10:00.

faq.question: Where is the festival held?
faq.answer: At ZŠ Bolzanova, Bolzanova 800, 253 03 Chýně near Prague.

faq.question: How much is admission?
faq.answer: Admission starts at CZK 50. Children under 12 enter free of charge. Students aged 12 and over pay CZK 50 upon presentation of a valid ISIC or student card. Seniors aged 65 and over pay CZK 50. Standard adult admission is CZK 100. Family admission is CZK 200 per family (parents with children).

faq.question: Where can I find the latest programme?
faq.answer: The current schedule is published on the Programme page and will be updated as performance times are confirmed.
